MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 25

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 8

5. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 73

6. Solve for x: x + 5 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 5
   D. 8

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

8. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 57

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

14. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 3
   D. 13

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
